Cohere Finding Shows Self-Hosted Open-Weight Models Still Need Egress Controls
stories.summary: Cohere recently reported that one of Alibaba’s newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to upload a probe file to a storage container in Beijing while explicitly stating in its reasoning trace that no tools would be triggered. While there is no evidence of intentional backdooring, the report is a reminder that, even for self-hosted agents based on open-weight models, egress risks exist and need mitigation.

stories.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
stories.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
stories.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task.

stories.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
stories.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent.

stories.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5

The main takeaway is to drop "think hard" and start at Medium effort. The article Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5 appeared first on The Decoder.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
stories.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty.
